Who We Are

Bridging Africa's energy access gap, one installation at a time.

Eastray Energy Solutions is a clean energy company delivering smart, scalable, and sustainable power to homes and businesses across Nigeria. We started in 2021 with a simple observation: Africa's growth was being throttled by unreliable, expensive power — and diesel generators were a costly, dirty bridge to nowhere.

Since then, we've built and commissioned solar and hybrid battery energy storage systems ranging from single-family homes to large commercial and institutional facilities — including hospitals, hospitality brands, churches, and industrial sites — engineering each system to the client's real load, not a generic package.

Today, our footprint spans eight cities and we're expanding into mobile EV charging infrastructure and franchise-based clean energy hubs — building the backbone for Africa's next phase of industrial and residential growth.

Our Journey

Built deliberately, one system at a time.

2021

Eastray Energy Solutions Founded

Started with a focus on residential solar in Awka, Anambra State — solving the everyday reality of unreliable grid power.

2022 – 2023

Expansion Into Commercial Systems

Delivered our first hybrid solar and battery energy storage systems for hospitality and commercial clients, scaling from 6kW residential units to 20kW+ commercial-grade installations.

2024 – 2025

Multi-City Footprint & Flagship Projects

Grew to eight cities across Nigeria. Delivered flagship installations including a 100kW/150kWh system and a comprehensive hybrid power proposal for a leading university's medical facilities.

2026 & Beyond

Mobile EV Charging & Franchise Hubs

Now building toward mobile EV charging infrastructure and a franchise-based clean energy hub model — engineered to scale reliable power access across Africa.
